lines.text: If you woke up with Gojo's Infinity, nothing could ever touch you.
lines.label: INFINITY

lines.text: Your Limitless technique places an infinite space between you and everything else.
lines.label: LIMITLESS

lines.text: Punches, bullets, even trucks slow down forever before they reach your skin.
But your brain would fry in seconds.
That's why you'd need the Six Eyes, which let you control it perfectly, and keep it on all day.
lines.label: SIX EYES

lines.text: Bored? Use Blue to pull everything toward you.
lines.label: LAPSE BLUE

lines.text: Use Red to blast it all away.
lines.label: REVERSAL RED

lines.text: Combine them, and Hollow Purple erases whatever it hits.
lines.label: HOLLOW PURPLE

lines.text: And if someone really annoys you, open your Domain.
lines.label: DOMAIN EXPANSION

lines.text: Unlimited Void floods their brain with infinite information, and they freeze.
lines.label: UNLIMITED VOID

lines.text: Toji's Inverted Spear can cancel your technique,
lines.label: WEAKNESS #1

lines.text: and Sukuna's World Cutting Slash cuts through space itself.
lines.label: WEAKNESS #2

lines.text: just never open a suspicious box.
lines.label: PRISON REALM
